name: Thang co
summary: The Mong pot on the Sunday stalls at Đắk R'Măng, sold beside corn wine. You can also find it at the market in Đắk Som.
origin: The 2024 visitor handbook on the Dak Nong provincial portal and VnExpress’s handbook of 10 Sep 2023 name thắng cố at the Đắk R'Măng market. Bao Lam Dong, 22 Sep 2023, names it as a Mong dish at Đắk R'Măng and Đắk Som.
howToEat: The handbook pairs it with rượu ngô at the Sunday market.
where: Chợ phiên Đắk R'Măng, Đắk R'Măng commune, Đắk Glong, on Sundays.
The market at Đắk Som, Đắk Glong.
seoTitle: Thang co at Dak R'Mang — Sunday market stew
seoDescription: Mong thắng cố on the Sunday stalls at Đắk R'Măng, and at the Đắk Som market.
